title: REQ · Player me endpoint validating session cookie
summary: GET /api/v1/player/me returns player for valid token and 401 otherwise
description: Context: tokens are issued by the session endpoint. Desired behavior: GET /api/v1/player/me reads the cookie, verifies HMAC and expiry, and returns the player JSON, or 401 JSON error for missing, tampered, malformed or expired tokens. Expected result: deterministic auth behavior. Why: later APIs reuse the same check.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid cookie, when GET /api/v1/player/me, then 200 and {"id":<playerID>}
Given no cookie, when requested, then 401
Given a token with altered signature or signed with another secret, when requested, then 401
Given an expired token, when requested, then 401
